# @three-ws/agent-glance

> Put a three.ws agent on any surface that has a slot: home screen widgets, README badges, Slack unfurls, and a live <agent-glance> web component.

@three-ws/agent-glance is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/agent-glance`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-glance/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-glance/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents

- [Source](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance)
